facts.text: The hotel is connected directly to The Avenues, which the hotel describes as Kuwait's largest mall.
facts.excerpt: Explore myriad shops and entertainment options at Kuwait’s largest mall, The Avenues, connected directly to the hotel.

facts.text: The Grand Mosque of Kuwait and the city center are 14 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Grand Mosque of Kuwait and the city center are 14 kilometers away.

facts.text: Kuwait International Airport is within 12 kilometers of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Jaber Al-Ahmad International Stadium and Kuwait International Airport are within 12 kilometers.

facts.text: ROKA serves modern Japanese cuisine, including sushi, sashimi and dishes cooked over hot coals on a traditional robata grill.
facts.excerpt: This award-winning restaurant’s modern Japanese cuisine features sushi, sashimi, and dishes prepared over hot coals on a traditional robata grill.

facts.text: Ava serves fresh, light Mediterranean fare drawing on the flavors of the French Riviera, Southern Italy and the Greek islands.
facts.excerpt: Chefs prepare fresh and light fare with Mediterranean flair at this stylish eatery that showcases the captivating flavors of the French Riviera, Southern Italy, and the Greek islands.

facts.text: Peacock Alley takes inspiration from cafes in Paris and New York and serves salads, gourmet sandwiches, chocolates and macarons.
facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from stylish cafes in Paris and New York, Peacock Alley serves fresh salads, gourmet sandwiches, exquisite chocolates, and macarons in an elegant setting.

facts.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa has eight treatment rooms, three hammams and two vitality pools.
facts.excerpt: featuring eight treatment rooms, three hammams, and two vitality pools.

facts.text: The spa has separate areas for men and women, with private arrival and consultation lounges.
facts.excerpt: We have separate areas for men and women, including private arrival and consultation lounges.

facts.text: The complimentary Kids Club is for children aged four to 12.
facts.excerpt: Our complimentary Kids Club keeps kids ages four to 12 engaged with spaces and activities designed just for them.

facts.text: The family-friendly outdoor pool is surrounded by lush greenery, and private cabanas can be reserved.
facts.excerpt: Take a dip in our family-friendly outdoor pool. Surrounded by lush greenery, it’s a relaxing place to escape to on warm days. Reserve a private cabana to elevate your experience.

facts.text: Ikaros Club benefits include private check-in and check-out and a private meeting room.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy many benefits, such as private check-in/out, a complimentary selection of international newspapers and magazines, high-speed Internet, and a private meeting room for every business need.

facts.text: The Ikaros Club offers breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner, dessert and complimentary beverages.
facts.excerpt: The Ikaros Club offers an international culinary experience, including breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner, dessert, and complimentary beverages.

facts.text: All rooms have 65-inch HDTVs, espresso machines and 400-thread-count sheets.
facts.excerpt: All rooms feature complimentary WiFi, 65-inch HDTVs, espresso machines, and 400-thread-count sheets.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have panoramic views of the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: featuring opulent, contemporary decor and panoramic views of the glittering skyline.

facts.text: The hotel has 13 flexible meeting rooms and a grand ballroom.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel offers 13 flexible meeting rooms and a grand ballroom for elegant occasions.

facts.text: Outdoor cabanas host family gatherings, romantic dinners and a cafe setting.
facts.excerpt: Our outdoor cabanas offer guests unforgettable experiences, whether it’s for family and friends gatherings, romantic dinners, or a cozy café setting.

facts.text: ROKA is described as award-winning, with no award or date given.
facts.excerpt: This award-winning Japanese restaurant serves food prepared on a traditional robata grill.
